findings.title: retryCount deletion not scoped to SMS method
findings.body: The second OR branch (`retryCount > 1`) has no `method: SMS` filter. This SMS cron job will therefore delete EMAIL and WHATSAPP workflow reminders whose retryCount exceeds 1, even if the email/WhatsApp crons use or later start using this column. Add `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` to that branch so other channels' reminders are not removed.

findings.title: Already-scheduled reminders can be deleted by retryCount condition
findings.body: The retryCount branch also has no `scheduled: false` filter. A reminder that failed once or twice and then scheduled successfully keeps its incremented retryCount and could match this delete. The DB row then disappears while the Twilio message is still queued, so it can no longer be cancelled when the booking is cancelled or rescheduled. Restrict the deletion to unscheduled reminders.
